rule: Never AI-edit more than once — each edit degrades quality
reason: AI editing is lossy; regeneration produces cleaner results

rule: For icons/small elements: regenerate from description, don't edit the crop
reason: AI editing on small images creates artifacts and blur

rule: Generate icon sets in one image then split for style consistency
Use chroma key (green/magenta) + Python removal for characters
Use rembg only for simple geometric shapes (circular buttons)
reason: rembg works well only on simple contours

rule: Never use white as chroma key color
reason: White blends with highlights and sword glints

rule: Select chroma key by contrast: warm content→green, cool→magenta
reason: Maximum color distance prevents content damage

rule: Bbox must be generous — bigger is better
Claude's visual bbox estimation has 20-50px error, always calibrate
For dense elements use pixel color scanning to find boundaries
reason: Edge detection > visual estimation for icon rows, button groups

rule: Store reference image in project config for cross-session consistency
reason: One effect image defines the entire game's visual direction

rule: All same-type assets should use identical prompt template with only content varied
Use NanoBanana style enum when available (anime/ghibli/pixel etc)
reason: Native style params produce more consistent results than prompt-only

rule: Always show generated image for user confirmation before post-processing
reason: Prevents wasted post-processing on rejected images

rule: Save version before any refinement operation
reason: Enables rollback if refinement makes things worse

rule: Update manifest and regenerate asset manager after every operation
reason: Keeps management view in sync with actual files

rule: Translate Chinese user descriptions to English for AI prompts
reason: AI models generate better images from English prompts

rule: Include engine-specific metadata in exports (Unity sprite_border etc)
reason: Reduces manual setup work in game engine

rule: Use plural directory names (characters/ icons/ backgrounds/)
